mentions.name: Skaldmaps
mentions.description: A mapping tool that lets users compare and rank all US ZIP codes, counties, and census tracts to find good places to move to or invest in. It grew out of an early prototype the author used to find their current house.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still noodling on https://skaldmaps.com, which lets you compare and rank all US ZIP codes, counties, and census tracts to find good places to move to and/or invest in.

Based on an early prototype that helped me find our current house.
mentions.author: otter-in-a-suit
